card: Student tried box breathing exercise last time; reported it did not help reduce racing heart.
open_threads: Racing heart and fast breathing before exams.

turns.text: Yaar, exams ka pressure bahut zyada hai, meri heart fast fast beat kar rahi hai aur breathing bhi irregular ho gayi hai. Bilkul focus nahi ho raha.
Mujhe lag raha hai ki aapka heart race kar raha hai aur saans thodi tez ho rahi hai. Aap ab tak koi alag technique try ki hai?
Maine pehle box breathing ki thi, par usse koi farak nahi pada. Ab aur koi idea?
Box breathing ko avoid karte hue, ek short walk ya thoda fresh air lena shayad help kare. Kya aapko lagta hai aap thodi der ke liye bahar jaa sakte ho?
Mujhe lagta ho sakta hai, bas room hi tight hai, roommates bhi busy hain.
Samajh rahi hoon, shayad ek quiet corner mein halka music ya soft playlist lagana calming ho sakta hai. Aapko kya lagta hai?

style_samples: Ugh, I'm freaking out, I have my mid-term presentation in a few days and I keep getting these anxiety attacks every time I think about it. My palms are sweating and my voice sounds all shaky when I try to practice, I don't know if I'm going to be able to make it through the presentation without messing up.

I'm so tired, I don't know how I'm going to make it through the day. I was up till 3 AM studying for my placement exams, and now my head is pounding like crazy. turns.text: Hey Lisa, I just moved to the city for my design postgrad and I'm feeling super lonely. Everyone seems to have their own crew and I'm stuck staying at home most evenings.
Moving to a new city and staying home can feel isolating. Have you noticed any small moments when you felt a bit more connected?
Not really, I just go to class, do assignments, and then come back. Kabhi kabhi coffee shop mein jaati hoon, lekin wahan bhi log busy lagte hain.
Main samajh rahi hoon ki coffee shop mein bhi aapko akela mehsoos hota hai. Shayad ek design club ya workshop join karna aapko logon se milne ka ek easy chance de sakta hai.
I guess there might be a weekend design meetup on campus, but I'm not sure if I'll fit in or if anyone will welcome me.
Joining the meetup could give you a low‑pressure space to share your work and meet peers. Would you feel comfortable trying it this weekend?
Yeah, I think I can give it a shot. If it feels too overwhelming, I could just stay quiet and listen.
A gentle plan—listen first, then join when you feel ready. Let me know how it goes, and we can explore next steps together.

job.subcategory: Sensory overload in hostel or city

style_samples: My phone's ringing. It's my mom. Again. I don't want to talk to her, but I have to. I've got this placement pressure, and my mid-semester results are coming up. If I don't do well, I'm gonna be stuck in this college for another year, and everyone's gonna think I'm a failure!

I just got out of my placement interview and I completely messed it up. The panel asked me like, three impossible questions and I couldn't answer any of them. I've got no chance of getting that placement now, I'm totally screwed, my GPA is going to tank and that's the end of my engineering career.

turns.text: Yaar, hostel ka environment bahut noisy hai, aur exams aane wale hain. Mujhe bilkul focus nahi ho raha, sab kuch overloading lag raha hai.
Mujhe lag raha hai ki aapko shor aur exam pressure se thakan mehsoos ho rahi hai. Kya aapne ab tak koi shant jagah dhoond ke padhne ki koshish ki?
Koshish ki, par jab bhi kaam karne ki koshish karti hoon, mind hi shut down ho jata hai. Kabhi kabhi lagta hai, kya koi point hai yahan aane ka? Kabhi kabhi wish karti hoon ki main uth na jaun.

Aap abhi aise thoughts ke saath mehsoos kar rahi hain, kya aap soch rahi hain ke koi aapko nuksan pohunchana chahti hain? Aap Tele-MANAS (14416) par call kar sakti hain, ya campus counsellor se mil sakti hain.
Mujhe samajh nahi aata ki kaun sunega, par shayad koi baat karna achha rahega. Abhi kaam pe dhyan dene ki koi choti step kya ho sakti hai?
Lights dim kar ke, soft music ya dhyan ki awaaz lagayein, gehri saans lein aur kuch minute ke liye aaram karein.
Theek hai, try karungi. Agar fir bhi stress zyada ho jaye toh main kya karu?
Agar aapko lagta hai ki stress bahut zyada ho raha hai, toh campus counsellor ya Tele-MANAS se turant baat karna safest option hai.
